---
name: Provider request
about: Ask for support for a new SERP engine or proxy provider
labels: provider
---

**Provider name + type**
<!-- e.g. "DuckDuckGo (SERP engine)" or "ProxyMesh (residential proxy)" -->

**Link to their API docs or dashboard**
<!-- Required if it's a SERP engine with an API. -->

**Pricing**
<!-- Rough — $/GB for proxies, $/1k queries for APIs. Dollar signs beat vague "cheap/expensive." -->

**Why open-serp-checker should support it**
<!-- Preferably: "it's free," "it's $X cheaper than Y at my volume," "I already pay for it," "it has a feature no other provider has that matters because Z." -->

**Can you contribute the PR?**
<!-- yes / no — adding a provider is ~50-100 lines following CONTRIBUTING.md. If you want it supported but can't write it, say so and we'll see. -->
